# Third-party resources

- Arimo variable font and Cousine: [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts), SIL Open Font License 1.1. Their complete notices are included here and in the APK's `assets/notices/`.
- AndroidX Core and Media3: [AndroidX](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx), Apache License 2.0.
- AndroidSVG 1.4: [BigBadaboom/androidsvg](https://github.com/BigBadaboom/androidsvg), Apache License 2.0.
- APK signature verification uses Google's apksig 8.13.2, Apache License 2.0, from the Android build-tools project.
- The Android system supplies its condensed sans face for the large preset digits. No Apple system font files are copied or distributed.

The common Apache 2.0 license text is bundled in `assets/notices/Apache-2.0.txt`. Project code is covered by the root [MIT license](../../LICENSE); original visual assets have a separate [contribution-only license](../../VISUAL-LICENSE.md). These project licenses do not replace the dependency notices. Original external design references are not shipping assets.
